rule.borderline_note: Rows flagged borderline are the ones where the two readings genuinely compete. Every one carries the reasoning that decided it, so a human can flip it and rerun.
rule.not_scheme: the money runs, builds, staffs or maintains an organisation or an asset, devolves general purpose funds to another tier of government, pays for the capacity of the delivery system rather than the benefit, discharges the state's obligation to its own serving or retired staff, services the state's own debt, or is an accounting or adjustment head
rule.scheme: the money buys an identifiable benefit received by a person or household: cash, a kit, food, a scholarship, a stipend, a fee waiver, a pension, insurance, a subsidy that lowers what that household pays, a loan or an interest subvention on its own borrowing, free travel, free power, a house, a named treatment entitlement, or training in which the trainee is himself the beneficiary class
rule.the_lines_that_did_the_work: Four lines decided most of the hard rows in West Bengal. FIRST, a public health programme delivered through the health system to the population at large is not a scheme: routine immunisation, pulse polio, vector control and disease surveillance fund the delivery system, while Swasthya Sathi, a card a household holds and presents, is a scheme. SECOND, the food subsidy splits on who is paid: a subsidy that lowers the price the ration card holder pays for rice, wheat or sugar is a scheme, and the transport subsidy, the fair price shop dealer's margin, the gunny bags and the paddy procurement cost under the same major head are not, because the payee is a carrier, a dealer or a mill. THIRD, an employment obligation is not a welfare scheme, which is Tamil Nadu's line and it holds here too: the death gratuity, leave encashment, the house building advance, the gallantry reward to a police officer, the ex-gratia to the family of a Volunteer Force member killed in action and the insurance cover for anganwadi workers are all cash to identifiable households and all are not_scheme, because the state pays them as an employer. FOURTH, the recovery mirror is not the provision it mirrors: 3,758 sub-heads carry object head 70 Deduct Recoveries and 760 carry a negative provision, and a row whose every object head is an accounting head is an accounting head even when it repeats a scheme's own name, which is why Lakshmir Bhandar appears at 2235-60-800-091 as a not_scheme.

sampling: Stratified by MAJOR HEAD function family (GOVERNANCE, SOCIAL, AGRI, RURAL, ECONOMY, TRANSFERS, a fixed partition of the 165 major heads defined in parse/classify_westbengal.py, with capital and loan heads reduced to the revenue head of the same function) crossed with allocation band (negative, nil, and quartiles of the 4,453 heads carrying a positive Budget Estimate), 30 non-empty strata. The major head is the axis and not the department, because West Bengal's departmental unit is the demand for grant and 350 of the 9,024 sub-heads sit under more than one demand, while the two-letter department tag the books append to a name is missing on 697 rows. A NEGATIVE provision gets its own band because 760 rows carry one and they are a distinct population, the Deduct Recoveries heads. Within a stratum rows are sorted by head of account and picked at even spacing, so the sample is reproducible without a random seed. Allocation is proportional to stratum size with a floor of 6, so the sample is close to self weighting; stratum_size and stratum_sampled are carried on every stratified row so a weighted estimate can be recomputed.

audit.what: Every row the classifier scores 6 or above that the stratified sample had not already covered. Together the two sets are a CENSUS of the published region and of the two bands below it, so the published list's precision is counted rather than estimated. The audit was made after the weights were fixed and was deliberately not fed back into them, which is why its findings are in known_errors rather than patched.

stratified.what: A probability sample of all 9,024 heads of account, stratified by major head function family crossed with allocation band. This is the only set the threshold sweep uses, because precision and recall estimated on anything else would not generalise to the rows the classifier has not seen.
